delta: Begin with no held route unless an exact focus address is supplied; do not assign a route from manifest recency.
Reuse the existing glyph rail as the default CURRENT HEADS chooser, in CURRENT's recorded order, excluding the root route because FIELD is already the current surface.
Keep RECENT and ALL as secondary views over the same route identities; label recency as chronology, not priority.
One activation selects shared focus; a second activation opens the held route through the existing scale-on-advance transition.
The existing held-object aperture remains the only place for native moves (≤3), forecast, witness and exact RETURN.
authority: CURRENT owns attention and source of the candidate heads.
FIELD selection changes focus only; it does not commit or mutate the host.
Native hosts own effects; RETURN owns observed evidence.
Head order and route recency do not imply priority.
preserved: No new queue, store, dashboard, planner, shell or route.
No synthesized head ranking; existing CURRENT order is displayed as recorded.
RECENT, AXIAL, MAP, LENS, TRACE, forecast and RETURN retain their existing owners and shared focus contract.
